verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The round-3 approval remains sound. The design record consistently rejects the fail-open GraphQL carve-out, preserves non-draft as unconditionally BUSY, and distinguishes the starvation-sweep diagnosis from current clearance. Its A1 path requires the human to re-read queue, arm, and `review:pass` state immediately before conversion, explicitly names the unavoidable two-request race and worst-case harm, and requires non-vacuous rendering tests in both admission and refusal directions. The A2 and overrule paths likewise carry explicit fail-closed, parity, budget, race, and test obligations. The sole executable-file change is explanatory documentation pointing to this record; it does not alter control flow or weaken a trust check. I found no remaining correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue in the diff.
